blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — An international cockfighting derby scheduled at a luxury integrated resort and casino here did not push through after organizers failed to secure the necessary permits from the Cebu City Government. Acting City Legal Officer Eleodoro Diaz IV confirmed the cancellation in a text message to CDN Digital on Monday, Nov. 2. “The event was cancelled,” Diaz said. “I don’t know their side. But on our side, they have not secured and/ or failed to secure the necessary permits.” READ: Ex-Cebu mayor Raymond Garcia appeals Ombud ruling over cockfight derbies The international derby was supposedly scheduled for Oct.
